notes: Prompt sha256 sha256:00a105b332827a249e76115332aef75dfdf7578e026c25fef1a35662a81efa32 over the DeepSeek-OCR2-vllm/config.py PROMPT '<image>\n<|grounding|>Convert the document to markdown.'; the HF model card prints the same prompt with a trailing space (sha256:a7e799e8c5c81073d707c01e12c7850d693ac14168a878ccfb3b4f70a6a49b58) and the adapter rejects that variant. Official alternative runtime: the vLLM OmniDocBench batch script (run_dpsk_ocr2_eval_batch.py) with vLLM V0 (VLLM_USE_V1=0), block_size 256, max_model_len 8192, gpu_memory_utilization 0.7, NoRepeatNGramLogitsProcessor(ngram_size=40, window_size=90, whitelist {128821, 128822}); it is not used because the arena worker serves one page per request and that script's only advantage is cross-page batching, and because its vendored model code would have to be copied into the image. max_new_tokens, no_repeat_ngram_size and temperature are fixed inside the checkpoint's remote code eval_mode branch, not passed by the adapter; they are recorded so the inference_config hash covers them. min_crops/max_crops (2/6) exist only in the vLLM config; the Transformers path derives the crop grid inside infer() from base_size/image_size/crop_mode. Base image ships Python 3.11 while the model card was tested on 3.12.9 - deviation recorded, the canary must confirm. Apache-2.0 is a copyright grant only: it is not patent freedom to operate. Canary must set max_concurrency_per_worker and shard_size_hint; 1 and 25 are conservative starting points from the 47.2 s/page historical 18-page measurement in masterplan section 5.1. Framework-floor audit (2026-09-03, after the GLM-OCR canary died on an unrecognised model_type): the required framework floor, what the pinned base image actually ships, the action taken and the evidence URLs are recorded in provenance.json under framework_floor_audit. bootstrap.sh asserts the pinned framework versions and that the framework recognises this checkpoint's architecture before anything starts.
